products.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
products.tagline_zh: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
products.description_zh: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.
